packageRules.description: Keep chart and image bumps in one PR, otherwise the chart rolls without its matching image tags
Digest pins for the ~130 tag-only images would otherwise open one PR each (no PR limits are set)

commitlint caps the header at 100 chars; the untouched 70-char depName pushes 'chore(deps): update <depName> docker tag to vX.Y.Z' to 112 and makes every bump of this image unmergeable. Only the display name changes.

bumpVersions.description: Flux keys the HelmChart artifact by the chart version, so an image-tag bump in an in-repo chart's values.yaml is never rendered onto the cluster unless Chart.yaml moves with it -- and nothing reports an error when it does not
bumpVersions.name: in-repo helm chart version
